(I) The matrix factorization algorithm is stable in the sense that the solution matrix and the ground truth are close to each other in the root mean square sense; (II) The matrix factorizations solution matrix is close to the ground truth subspace; (III) The prediction errors of individual users are bounded by the distance between the solution subsapce and the ground truth.
